decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The new sash windows forming part of the development hereby approved shall be vertical sliding sash frames within a recessed box frame. The windows shall comprise painted softwood, with the sashes counterbalanced by weighted cords and pulleys. The windows shall match the design, mouldings and glazing bar pattern of [INSERT - specify which window]. The new sash windows shall thereafter be retained as such.
All window reveals on the external faces of the development hereby permitted shall be set in 115mm (minimum) from the external face of the building and thereafter retained as such.

The development hereby permitted shall be constructed entirely of the materials details shown on plan No. [INSERT - XX ] /in accordance with the approved materials schedule [INSERT - XX] unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting documents and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing number (add reference number)dated (date on the plans) - documents entitled (document title) dated (date on the document)
description: Alteration to window and door openings at ground floor level of the principal elevation to facilitate the installation of a timber sash window (white) and a front door including fanlight. Enlargement of existing ground floor rear window opening to facilitate the installation of an aluminium framed window/ door.
